correctness.rationale: For positive speeds, summing the three implicit kick equations gives an exact factored cyclic identity; its only possible zero set forces two equal speeds and hence a sine-zero phase. Conversely, at those phases the updates are a zero kick followed by equal and opposite kicks. The selected larger quadratic root admits a negative kick exactly for normalized drive at least -(3-2sqrt(2)), and it returns from a positive kick exactly if the inverse speed ratio is at least sqrt(2)-1. This yields the two inclusive sharp speed thresholds without requiring differentiability at a fold. Exact symbolic factorization, algebraic boundary witnesses and finite branch checks reproduced from verify.py. No finite enumeration is used for a universal implication.
